cause: Stage3D commit_word commits the final terminal-modified child into MapState; MapState.commit updates route current from the committed sequence. The terminal selector therefore can transiently alter route memory.
required_fix: Commit the v22.2 base_child to the route/MapState in commit_word, while committing the Stage3D final_child only to visible surface/prev_terminal in commit_surface. Then rerun 3E-3G.
